Orca refix refutation (Run wf_4e1fd27d-f57, astra, detached worktree at 07b5314) found 2 confirmed defects. Full report: ~/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/reviews/orca-refix-refute.txt; evidence in orca-refix-refute-evidence/.
- **BLOCKER:** a failed initial import's rollback removes newer user tabs and dirty-file rows (cross-machine-recovery-apply.ts:205, -rollback.ts:51).
  - An overlapping retry can report alreadyApplied while its predecessor's rollback leaves nothing imported. The host timeout at recovery-runtime-host.ts:96 leaves the renderer request alive, which allows the overlap.
  - Reproduced both with mocks and with the real Store durable queue.
- **MAJOR:** a groupless client view that keeps a terminal row strands its binding (recovery-import-plan.ts:98-110).

pnpm tc passed. 99/103 tests passed; the 4 failures are these two defects. Picker/bridge, dormant auto-launch and local-only routing checks all passed.

Fix lane: Run wf_480fe4d1-dac on cc-sync/xmr-refix2 from 07b5314, in an isolated worktree while rendered QA owns xmr. Failing-first repros, then targeted refutation. It merges into cc-sync/cross-machine-recovery after QA, with the affected QA scenarios re-run.
